def determine_season(date):
    if date.month in [11, 12, 1, 2, 3, 4]:
        return 'hot'
    else:
        return 'cold'

# Define the directory containing the CSV files
directory = '/media/shilpa/Expansion/ostia_mhw_fiji/'

# List all files in the directory and filter for files that start with "New Caledonia_spatial"
ostia_files = [file for file in os.listdir(directory) if file.startswith("Fiji_spatial")]

# Initialize an empty list to store DataFrames
dfs_ostia = []

# Read each CSV file and append the DataFrame to the list
for file in ostia_files:
    file_path = os.path.join(directory, file)
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    dfs_ostia.append(df)

# Concatenate all DataFrames into a single DataFrame
concatenated_df_ostia = pd.concat(dfs_ostia, ignore_index=True)
